infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Drivers: RIO GPS shares your location with your company while you're signed in to the driver app, including when the app is closed, so they can see where you are and keep your loads up to date. Owners and dispatchers: location is used only to show your own position on the map.
